description.narrative: Our YFC Uganda project group is applying for a Partner Identification as we want to meet up with Watoto Church in Uganda for a potential future partnership. We have a special heart for women and girls, and we desire to see a global change for girls and women's rights as well as gender equity. Watoto Church is working hard to fight the challenges young girls in Uganda are dealing with; Many girls drop out of school from an early age due to period poverty (lack of menstrual hygiene management), which unfortunately often leads to child marriages and teenage pregnancies. Moreover, we would like to visit Set Her Free to get inspiration, because they as well strive to make an impact in the lives of girls and women. The aim of this Partner Identification visit is to establish the foundation of a sustainable partnership with a mutual vision to empower children and youths in Uganda.
